messages:
maria: morning — nightly sweep failed at 03:12 UTC. bench-suite spiked, one test kept OOMing. Pinging eng-ml. Anyone on call?
cron-bot: [automated] Job nightly-sweep | job_id=ns-20260301-03 | status=FAILED | exit=137
tzach: logs?
maria: log snippet below:
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory when allocating 1.2 GiB (GPU 0)
Allocated: 7.8 GiB
Available: 8.0 GiB
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/bench/runner.py", line 214, in run_suite
    run_test(test)
  File "/srv/bench/tests/inference_test.py", line 87, in run
    model.generate(... )
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory
```
alex: I just saw that. Nightly was picking up the `quant-branch` image for a few jobs. Some quant kernels temporarily use more scratch memory.
lucy: can we rerun without that branch? Otherwise rerun and bisect later.
alex: kicked a manual rerun of nightly-sweep on the same pool without `quant-branch` flag — CI run: https://ci.redwood/suite/1842356789/run/2 (watching logs)
ron: I'll start a bisect across commits 5f3a2d..c2b7fa to see where memory regressed. Assigning to me.
tzach: if rerun passes we should still mark this test flaky and add retry=2 to the job config. It's noisy and blocks assurance.
maria: agreed. If rerun fails, we should stop other dependent cron jobs — scheduler should not cascade failures.
alex: rerun finished PASS ✅ — bench-suite all green on run/2. looks intermittent but correlated with `quant-branch`.
ron: bisect started. first checkpointed job scheduled. will report any failing commit.
lucy: opened INF-1123 to add retry=2 and to pin nightly to stable image for 48h: https://go/INF-1123. PR will include a quick note in the console rollout.
maria: thanks all. I'll add a short postmortem note to the daily ops doc in the morning and tag infra. :memo:
alex: :thumbsup:
cron-bot: [automated] Downstream jobs resumed for nightly-sweep (reason: rerun succeeded).
